Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the "Analysis of Previous Result" section of Step 6. The WebSurfer correctly extracted from the Baseball-Reference page that the 1916 New York Giants had a "Longest Winning Streak" of 26 games. The Planner then incorrectly interpreted this to mean the streak included a tie game ("includes a mid-streak tie, which interrupts a consecutive wins-only streak") and falsely concluded that the uninterrupted wins-only run was only 22 games (attributing this to the 2017 Indians). This is a hallucination; Baseball-Reference's "Longest Winning Streak" stat explicitly counts wins and ties as part of the streak (as confirmed by the Wikipedia source cited earlier in the conversation which states "tie games do not end a team's winning streak"). The 22-game streak by the 2017 Indians is a separate record often cited for "wins only" (excluding ties), but the Planner conflated the two facts and used the incorrect interpretation to generate the final wrong answer.
